title: Russian Drone Strikes Kyiv-Warsaw Train Locomotive Near Polish Border in Western Ukraine Barrage
detail: Russia launched a mass overnight drone assault on September 13 that heavily targeted western Ukraine, far from the front line. A Russian drone struck the locomotive of a Kyiv-Warsaw international train near Yahodyn on Ukraine's border with Poland — about 2 km from the crossing — damaging the train, though no passengers were injured. Nationwide, Russian strikes killed at least six civilians and injured 43 others over the preceding 24 hours, according to Ukrainian officials. A separate diplomatic train carrying former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other former European leaders returning from Kyiv's YES security conference had made an early departure from Yahodyn shortly before the strike "due to the constant threat of Russian strikes," Ukrainian Railways said, and had already crossed into Poland when the regular civilian train — on which former CIA Director David Petraeus was traveling separately — was hit. Ukraine's rail operator said it was "quite likely" a targeted attack; Kyiv cited the incident as evidence of the growing threat Russia poses to Europe.

title: Ukraine's GUR Strikes Slavyansk-on-Kuban and Nizhnekamsk Refineries, Igniting Major Fires
detail: Ukraine's Main Intelligence Directorate (GUR) said its drones struck two major Russian petrochemical hubs overnight into September 13: the Slavyansk-ECO oil refinery in Slavyansk-on-Kuban, Krasnodar Krai (previously hit in June), and the Nizhnekamsk industrial cluster in Tatarstan, home to Tatneft's TANECO refinery, TAIF-NK and the Nizhnekamskneftekhim synthetic rubber plant roughly 1,500 km from Ukraine. Both strikes ignited large fires, with the Tatarstan blaze visible for dozens of kilometers. GUR said the operation was carried out jointly by two intelligence units with Ukraine's Defense Forces. Ukraine's General Staff separately reported cumulative Russian personnel losses of approximately 1,506,900 through September 13, including about 1,520 over the prior 24 hours. No map coordinates are plotted for the Nizhnekamsk strike as the target lies far outside this tracker's Ukraine-theater map bounds.

title: Trump Tells Zelenskyy to Stop Striking Russian Diesel Fuel Supplies
detail: US President Donald Trump told Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to halt Ukraine's drone campaign targeting Russian diesel fuel infrastructure, adding a new American pressure point on Kyiv's cross-border energy strike strategy. The directive represents an escalation of US efforts to constrain Ukrainian operations deep inside Russia as Washington pursues a negotiated ceasefire, and comes amid Ukraine's ongoing GUR-led drone campaign against Russian refineries and petrochemical facilities.
